indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX jra_html_evidence_pkey ON public.jra_html_evidence USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX jra_html_evidence_race_key_html_sha256_key ON public.jra_html_evidence USING btree (race_key, html_sha256)
CREATE INDEX jra_html_evidence_recent ON public.jra_html_evidence USING btree (race_key, fetched_at DESC)
initial.job21_queue_clause: update public.jra_live_queue q set status='pending', attempts=0, last_error=null, updated_at=now() where q.race_date=((now() at time zone 'Asia/Tokyo')::date) and q.status='done' and q.updated_at < now()-interval '30 minutes' and exists (select 1 from public.official_races r where r.race_date=q.race_date and r.track=q.track and r.race_no=q.race_no and r.circuit='JRA' and r.post_time is not null and r.post_time > now())
